matured_entry_cohort.definition: scored trades opened at least max_hold (10080 min) before the scoring end, excluding entries opened in [hole_start - 10080 min, hole_end + 1440 min] of any hole of their symbol (entry time only).  It omits (and counts below) entries on stalled symbols that never closed and entries of that age whose time stop landed on a short gap and closed after the scoring end

open_positions_mark_to_market.note: last close vs entry, minus the taker round trip; funding not included

interim_censoring_note: until the 7-day time stop of the first entries has passed (plus the lag window), closed trades over-represent fast take-profits and the scored mean is biased upward; matured_entry_cohort (per book) is the view that is not biased by this at any date, and open_positions_mark_to_market shows the open side

review.note: descriptive only; a selected cell, one sample; no claim of an edge

stamp_convention: daily realized account return of UTC day d is stamped at 00:00 UTC of day d+1
